description.zh: 语文素养是借助语言观察、理解、关联、推理、组织、表达与创造的元思维操作。内容难度对标同级中英文教材，问法和编排从思维角度设计：知识是载体，思维才是目标。
description.en: Language & Literacy is the meta-thinking operation of using language to observe, understand, connect, infer, organise, express and create. Content difficulty is benchmarked to same-grade Chinese and English curricula; the questions and sequencing are designed around thinking: knowledge is the carrier, thinking is the goal.

ageRange.noteZh: K1–K2 用 CSS 场景（背景色块 + 定位 emoji）+ 自动语音落地，不识字也能玩；G1–G2 能独立读短文。G3–G6 仍未实现。
ageRange.noteEn: K1-K2 use CSS scenes (background gradient + positioned emoji) plus auto-narration, playable without reading; G1-G2 read a short text independently. G3-G6 are not yet implemented.

educationReference.policyZh: 对标，不复制；换角度，不换难度。素材原创（公有领域作品除外），体裁、主题、字词量与句长对标同级教材；每道题带课标/教材锚点和思维层级两个标签。
educationReference.policyEn: Benchmark, never copy; change the angle, not the difficulty. Passages are original (public-domain works excepted), with genre, theme, vocabulary load and sentence length benchmarked to same-grade curricula; every item carries a curriculum anchor and a thinking-level tag.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 听故事、看图：找画面细节，说出人物的心情。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Listen and look: find picture details, name a character's feeling.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 看连环画：排顺序，猜接下来会发生什么。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Picture strips: order the frames, predict what comes next.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 读短故事：找关键细节，从动作神态推断心情并找证据，靠顺序词理清先后，比较词语的效果。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Short stories: find key details, infer feelings from actions and point to evidence, order events by signal words, compare word effects.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 读较长的故事：整合多处线索，检验人物的观点，分清“写的顺序”和“发生的顺序”，换角色思考。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Longer stories: combine several clues, check a character's claim, separate the order of telling from the order of events, think as another character.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 说明性短文与寓言：提取要点，理解寓意。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Short informational texts and fables: key points and the moral.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 根据对象和场合选择语气与用词。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Choose tone and wording for an audience and occasion.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 比较两篇文本的观点，评价作者的写法。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Compare viewpoints across two texts, evaluate the author's craft.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 综合观察、结构与表达完成创作，并对照他人想法修改。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Combine observation, structure and expression into a piece, then revise it against others' ideas.

exercises.descriptionZh: 《借伞》：细节、心情与证据、隐含原因、事件排序、“撑着/拿着”，结尾续编。
exercises.descriptionEn: Chinese G1 story: details, feeling + evidence, hidden cause, event order, word choice, continuation.

exercises.descriptionZh: 《雪地上的脚印》：线索甄别、推断与证据、倒叙时间词、写的顺序 vs 发生的顺序，换角色想。
exercises.descriptionEn: Chinese G2 story: weighing clues, inference + evidence, flashback time words, telling order vs. event order, another character's view.

exercises.descriptionZh: Max and the Kite：原因、证据、顺序词 Soon、“up, up, up”的效果，续编。
exercises.descriptionEn: Cause, evidence, the signal word 'Soon', the effect of 'up, up, up', continuation.

exercises.descriptionZh: The Class Garden：线索甄别、检验人物观点、开头-经过-结尾、munching 的效果，换角色想。
exercises.descriptionEn: Weighing clues, checking a character's claim, beginning-middle-end, the effect of 'munching', another character's view.

aggregationRules.ruleZh: ccr_slot / ccr_reflect 不计分：checkAnswer 恒为真，文案不出现“对/错”；孩子的选择只进入报告 context 的 guidedCreate 字段。
aggregationRules.ruleEn: ccr_slot / ccr_reflect are never scored: checkAnswer is always true and no right/wrong wording is shown; the child's picks go only into the report context's guidedCreate field.

aggregationRules.ruleZh: 每题记录首次作答是否正确与 errorType（items / byUnit / errorTypes 字段），用于区分“结论错”和“证据错”。
aggregationRules.ruleEn: Each item records first-try correctness and errorType (items / byUnit / errorTypes fields), to tell a wrong answer apart from right-answer-wrong-evidence.

statistics.note: shell.report() fires once per unit, so per-item data is folded into that report's context payload.
